json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Job Started
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, flowName: "job-worker-flow", step: "JOB_STARTED", jobId: vars.jobId, claimId: vars.claimId, contentDocumentId: vars.contentDocumentId }]

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Job Completed
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, flowName: "job-worker-flow", step: "JOB_COMPLETED", jobId: vars.jobId, partsCreated: sizeOf(vars.createdParts default []) }]

set-variable.doc:name: Set Error Details (Comprehensive)

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Job Failed (Enhanced)
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, flowName: "job-worker-flow", step: "JOB_FAILED", jobId: vars.jobId, claimId: vars.claimId default null, contentDocumentId: vars.contentDocumentId default null, errorDetails: { errorType: error.errorType.identifier default "unknown", errorNamespace: error.errorType.namespace default "unknown", message: error.description default "no description", detailedMessage: error.detailedDescription default null, cause: error.cause.description default null, causeType: error.cause.errorType.identifier default null, failedComponent: error.failingComponent default "unknown" } }]

logger.doc:name: Log Exception Details
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'EXCEPTION_DETAILS | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | exception=' ++ write(error.cause, 'application/json', {'indent': false})]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { jobId: vars.jobId, status: vars.jobStatus default "PROCESSING", claimId: vars.claimId, contentDocumentId: vars.contentDocumentId, sourceContentVersionId: vars.sourceContentVersionId, correlationId: vars.correlationId, createdAt: vars.jobCreatedAt default now(), updatedAt: now(), progress: vars.jobProgress default { currentStep: "INITIALIZING", percentComplete: 0, message: "Job started" }, (result: { partsCreated: sizeOf(vars.createdParts default []), parts: vars.createdParts }) if vars.jobStatus == "COMPLETED", (error: vars.errorDetails) if vars.jobStatus == "FAILED" }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var steps = ["VALIDATING_CLAIM", "VALIDATING_DOCUMENT", "FETCHING_CONTENT", "SPLITTING", "UPLOADING", "COMPLETED"] var currentStepIndex = (steps indexOf vars.currentStep) default 0 --- { currentStep: vars.currentStep default "PROCESSING", percentComplete: ((currentStepIndex + 1) / sizeOf(steps) * 100) as Number {format: "0"}, message: vars.progressMessage default "Processing...", (partsUploaded: vars.partsUploaded) if vars.partsUploaded?, (totalParts: vars.totalParts) if vars.totalParts? }

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Callback Start
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, flowName: "salesforce-callback-subflow", step: "CALLBACK_START", jobId: vars.jobId, claimId: vars.claimId, partsCount: sizeOf(vars.createdParts default []) }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { claimId: vars.claimId as String, sourceContentDocumentId: vars.contentDocumentId as String, sourceContentVersionId: vars.contentVersion.Id as String, originalFileName: (vars.contentVersion.Title as String) ++ "." ++ (vars.contentVersion.FileExtension as String), originalSizeBytes: vars.contentVersion.ContentSize as Number, originalPageCount: vars.pdfPageCount as Number, partCount: sizeOf(vars.createdParts default []), status: vars.jobStatus default "COMPLETED", dryRun: false, parts: vars.createdParts default [] map ((part, index) -> { partNumber: part.partNumber as Number, pageStart: part.pageStart as Number, pageEnd: part.pageEnd as Number, pageCount: part.pageCount as Number, sizeBytes: part.sizeBytes as Number, sizeMb: part.sizeMb as Number, contentVersionId: part.contentVersionId as String, contentDocumentId: part.contentDocumentId as String, contentDocumentLinkId: part.contentDocumentLinkId as String, fileName: part.fileName as String }), correlationId: vars.correlationId as String, timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import java!com::lwcc::pdf::SalesforceFileDownloader --- SalesforceFileDownloader::getTokenInfo( p('sfdc.endpoint'), p('secure::sfdc.consumerkey'), p('sfdc.principal'), (mule.home default '') ++ '/apps/' ++ (app.name default 'lwcc-sf-doc-split-sys-api') ++ '/' ++ p('mule.env') ++ '-jks.jks', p('secure::sfdc.password'), p('sfdc.alias') )

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Callback Success
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, flowName: "salesforce-callback-subflow", step: "CALLBACK_SUCCESS", jobId: vars.jobId, httpStatusCode: attributes.statusCode }]

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Callback Failed

os:store.doc:name: Store Failed Callback

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Stored for Retry
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, flowName: "salesforce-callback-subflow", step: "CALLBACK_RETRY_QUEUED", jobId: vars.jobId, storeName: "Failed_Callbacks_Store" }]

logger.doc:name: Log Cleanup Started
logger.message: JOB_CLEANUP_STARTED | Cleaning up expired job records

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Failure Callback Start
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, flowName: "salesforce-failure-callback-subflow", step: "CALLBACK_FAILURE_START", jobId: vars.jobId, claimId: vars.claimId, errorCode: vars.errorDetails.errorCode default "UNKNOWN" }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import java!com::lwcc::pdf::SalesforceFileDownloader --- SalesforceFileDownloader::getTokenInfo( p('sfdc.endpoint'), p('secure::sfdc.consumerkey'), p('sfdc.principal'), (mule.home default '') ++ '/apps/' ++ (app.name default 'lwcc-sf-doc-split-sys-api') ++ '/' ++ p('mule.env') ++ '-jks.jks', p('secure::sfdc.password'), p('sfdc.alias') )

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Failure Callback Sent
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, flowName: "salesforce-failure-callback-subflow", step: "CALLBACK_FAILURE_SENT", jobId: vars.jobId }]
